Symbols:
  \nu_{N}: Nitrate uptake rate [mol N (mol C)^-1 time^-1] (computed)
  Q_{nm}: Maximum nitrogen quota used in the nitrate-uptake regulation law [mol N (mol C)^-1] (parameter)
  Q_{n}: Total nitrogen-to-carbon ratio [mol N (mol C)^-1] (computed)
  q_{n}: Nitrogen quota parameter for carbon partitioning [mol N (mol C)^-1] (parameter)
  \nu_{nm}: Maximum nitrate uptake rate [mol N (mol C)^-1 time^-1] (parameter)
  S_{NO3}: Concentration of nitrate as N in the reactor [mol N m^{-3}] (computed)
  S_{NO3_0}: Initial nitrate concentration [mol N m^-3] (variable)
  X_{N}: Concentration of cellular nitrogen as N [mol N m^{-3}] (computed)
  X_{C}: Total cellular carbon concentration, used to represent non-Chl-a biomass together with X_{chl}. [mol C m^{-3}] (variable)
  X_{cd}: Concentration of functional biomass (algal biomass excluding carbohydrates and neutral lipids) as C [mol X_{cd}-C m^{-3}] (computed)
  P: Photosynthesis rate normalized to functional biomass [mol C (mol X_{cd}-C)^{-1} d^{-1}] (computed)
  m: Functional biomass degradation rate [time^-1] (parameter)
  X_{carb}: Concentration of carbohydrates as C [mol X_{carb}-C m^{-3}] (computed)
  m_{c}: Respiration rate constant. [time^{-1}] (parameter)
  k_{mc}: Light-response coefficient in the exponential adjustment of carbohydrate respiration. [irradiance^{-1}] (parameter)
  I_{avg_R}: Reference average light intensity used to adjust parameters for different light conditions. [mol photons m^{-2} d^{-1}] (computed)
  m_{cN}: Coefficient for the nitrogen-uptake-associated carbohydrate consumption term. (parameter)
  \beta: Coefficient for nitrogen-uptake-linked neutral-lipid formation. (parameter)
  k_{nl}: Light-response coefficient in the exponential term for neutral-lipid synthesis. [irradiance^{-1}] (parameter)
  I_{avg}: Average light intensity inside the reactor, averaged over the optical path. [mol photons m^{-2} d^{-1}] (computed)
  q_{nl}: Rate portion of carbon redirection from carbohydrate to lipid accumulation [unitless] (computed)
  X_{nl}: Concentration of neutral lipids as C [mol X_{nl}-C m^{-3}] (computed)
  X_{chl}: Concentration of Chl-a as C [mol X_{chl}-C m^{-3}] (computed)
  \theta: Maximum Chl-a:N ratio [-] (parameter)
  k_{chl}: Light-response coefficient governing the light-dependent Chl-a synthesis term. [irradiance^{-1}] (parameter)
  m_{chl}: Chl-a degradation rate [time^-1] (computed)

Model-wide assumptions (already recorded, do not repeat):
  - Optical cross‑section parameters a and b are taken as constant regardless of cultivation conditions.
  - The composition of functional biomass is fixed to CH1.8O0.5N0.2.
  - Nitrate uptake is assumed to equal the nitrate removed from the medium.

laws.description: Nitrate uptake per functional biomass increases with extracellular nitrate normalized to its initial concentration and is downregulated as the cellular nitrogen quota approaches its maximum.
laws.quote: As a result, the nitrate uptake rate $ v_{N} $ in eq 17 is linearly related to the extracellular nitrate concentration $ S_{NO3} $ and is divided by the initial concentration $ S_{NO3\_{0}} $ to offset the effect of initial nitrate level. Additionally, the maximum nitrate uptake rate $ v_{nm} $ is regulated by the nitrogen quota to potentially limit the maximum amount of nitrogen that cells can assimilate.
laws.law_type_reason: It specifies a nitrate-uptake kinetic relation rather than a conserved-quantity balance.
